hero.lead: More than a destination. A place you come to know up close: its paths, its people, its own pace.

philosophy.label: The idea
philosophy.statement: You can visit a place and leave having seen only the view. Or you can live it: walk its paths, sit at its table, listen to its stories.
philosophy.aside: OurWay exists for the second kind of journey. For people who want to get to know a place, not just pass through it.

story.label: What you discover
story.title: A place is many things at once

blocks.title: The landscape is where it begins
blocks.body: Mountains, gorges, rivers, coastlines. The ground under your feet, light that shifts through the day, a kind of quiet the city never offers. Nature isn't a backdrop — it's the first thing that introduces you to a place.

blocks.title: What keeps a place alive
blocks.body: Feasts, dances, music, skills handed down through generations. Every region has its own way of living and remembering — and it's worth seeing up close, with respect.

blocks.title: Encounters outlast photographs
blocks.body: The shepherd in the meadow, the family at the café on the square, the craftsman in his workshop. You don't just see the people of a place — you talk with them.

blocks.title: An identity no guidebook can hold
blocks.body: The stone of the houses, the bridges, the hilltop chapels, the flavours. Everything that makes somewhere resemble nowhere else. That's what we look for, and what we want to share.

hero.title: Places with character
hero.lead: We're drawn to places with an identity — where nature, history and people still live side by side.

destinations.intro: Our specific destinations will be announced soon. Until then, these are the landscapes that draw us.

landscapes.title: Mountain villages
landscapes.body: Stone houses, squares shaded by plane trees, arched bridges and cobbled paths. Communities that still keep their own rhythm.

landscapes.title: Gorges and rivers
landscapes.body: Landscapes carved by water. Cool air, stone, greenery and a stillness that slows you down.

landscapes.title: Coastlines and cliffs
landscapes.body: The sea as people who live beside it know it — not just a beach, but a way of life.

landscapes.title: Plains and countryside
landscapes.body: Pastures, olive groves, small chapels. The rural life that shaped the land and its food.

destinations.ctaBody: Tell us where you'd like to go and what you'd like to experience there.

hero.title: Our way of getting to know a place
hero.lead: The name says almost everything. OurWay: the path we choose, and the way we walk it.

about.meaningTitle: The way is more than the route
meaningBody: Many people travel to see. We believe the real experience begins when you stop looking from a distance and step inside a place.
That's why OurWay doesn't simply plan routes from A to B. It plans time: time to understand where you are, who lives there and what this place has to tell you.

values.title: Authenticity
values.body: We show places as they are, not as a brochure would like them to be.

values.title: Respect
values.body: For nature, for local communities, for their traditions.

values.title: Connection
values.body: Between people, and between people and the place.

values.title: Curiosity
values.body: The urge to ask, to try, to discover something beyond the obvious.

about.natureCultureBody: In Greece, landscape and culture are inseparable. The paths were opened by people, the villages built from the mountain's own stone, the songs tell of the sea and the pastures. You can't truly know one without the other.
about.evolvingBody: OurWay is at its beginning. Our experiences, places and partnerships are taking shape step by step — carefully, and with people who share the same outlook.

sections.title: What we collect
sections.body: Through the contact form we collect only what you give us: your name, email, your message and — if you choose — phone number, interest, date and number of people.

sections.title: Why we use it
sections.body: Solely to respond to your request. We don't use it for advertising and we don't sell it.

sections.title: How it is transmitted
sections.body: Your message is sent securely (HTTPS) and delivered to the OurWay team through an email delivery service. The website does not store messages in a database.
